fit_probability_bins: 601 fixed logit centers from -30 to30 by0.1; nearest-center binning, no outcome/VALID adaptation
fitting: Aggregate known status counts per landmark; equal landmark weighting. Isotonic PAV or constrained logistic on weighted bin means.
inference: Continuous strict monotone map, unquantized raw probability, epsilon identity mixture0.01 is part of predictive distribution, not a scoring floor
proper_score: Stable analytic interval difference in survival/probability domain; no NLL clipping
rolling_window: Known completion in last14/28 days; unresolved known censor status uses fresh observation cutoff, never future elapsed. Historical CAL censor bounds are not advanced without observation.
April: All maps frozen preApril; no April calibration updates
